versions.changelog:
Initial release of screen-off CLI for macOS:

- Toggle any connected display on or off by ID, name, or index.
- Supports listing displays and controlling screens from the command line.
- Includes options for force toggle, permanent off state, and fuzzy name matching.
- Requires macOS and Python 3.8 or higher; no extra dependencies.
- Based on zy0816/ScreenOff using CoreGraphics/SkyLight APIs.
